elements.requirement: A person convicted upon an indictment of any assault occasioning actual bodily harm is liable to be kept in penal servitude.
elements.quote: Whosoever shall be convicted upon an indictment of any assault occasioning actual bodily harm shall be liable to be kept in penal servitude
